title: STARMENDER
logline: A falling star lands in a girl's mittens: a glass bead trailing a snapped thread. The night sky is a great velvet cloth, and it is tearing. She rides a giant needle up to sew it shut, runs out of thread, and finishes the seam with her red scarf.

shots.name: A star in the palm
shots.note: Macro. Night rooftop. A falling star streaks in (0.9) and lands in cupped mittens (1.6): a glowing glass bead with a frayed thread.

shots.name: Her eyes
shots.note: Close-up of Io lit from below by the bead. More stars fall. Her eyes lift; push in to one eye: a golden gash reflected in the iris.

shots.name: The tear
shots.note: Wide reveal from behind her on the roof: a huge golden rip across the night sky, stars raining out of it. Awe.

shots.name: Launch
shots.note: She crouches on a giant silver needle (anticipation 11.5-12.2), launches at 12.2 and rockets up past the roofs.

shots.name: Through the clouds
shots.note: Inside cloud (muffled) until 15.6, then bursts out above a moonlit cloud sea, gold light from the tear above.

shots.name: The sky is cloth
shots.note: Slow motion. She rolls and trails a mitten along the sky: indigo velvet, stars are glass beads hanging on threads, chiming.

shots.name: Canyon of light
shots.note: Majestic wide under the cloth: the tear is a canyon of blazing gold, lips billowing like mountain ranges; she is tiny.

shots.name: First stitch
shots.note: She dives at the lip. PIERCE at 24.3: needle punches up through the cloth into the blinding light beyond.

shots.name: Whipstitch
shots.note: Chase shot: she corkscrews around the seam, piercing a lip every 0.5 s (26.5 ... 30.5), the tear cinching shut behind her.

shots.name: Half mended
shots.note: Vast wide from below: half the tear is a glowing zigzag seam; shafts of gold light narrowing over the cloud sea.

shots.name: Out of thread
shots.note: The spool spins empty (35.0). The thread end whips out of the needle eye (35.2). Stitches start popping (from 35.6), light bursts back.

shots.name: The catch
shots.note: Slow motion, sound sucked away. She lunges and catches the fleeing thread end in her mitten (38.2). Her scarf blows across her face. She decides.

shots.name: Red to gold
shots.note: Macro: a strand of red yarn from her scarf knotted to the gold thread; the knot pulls tight (41.6).

shots.name: The red run
shots.note: Final run. The scarf unravels from her neck into the needle as she stitches the last stretch in red (pierces 43.0 ... 46.5).

shots.name: The pull
shots.note: Last pierce 47.6. She braces on the cloth and hauls (48.2-50.6): the whole seam cinches shut in a wave racing to the horizon. Sky closes at 50.6: darkness, silence.

shots.name: Bare neck
shots.note: Close-up in cool starlight. Scarf gone, a last tail of red yarn in her mitten. A bead swings beside her (chime 53.2). She smiles.

shots.name: A new constellation
shots.note: Wide from the village roof: the sky is whole; the seam is a new zigzag constellation, its last stretch red. Title 57.0. Fade 59.3-60.

audio_cues.desc: High mountain night: soft airy wind, very quiet. Warm pp pad (Bm9 colour) fades in from 0.3.
Falling star: thin glassy descending whistle, panning right to centre.
Star lands in mittens: soft 'tink' of glass on wool + sparkle shimmer tail.
Her theme, first statement: music box / celesta, pp, 4 notes then 4 notes.
Pad darkens; low drone creeps in from 6.0 and crescendos into 7.5.
More falling stars: 4-5 faint glassy descending whistles and tings, scattered in stereo (5.0, 5.6, 6.1, 6.5, 6.9).
REVEAL. Deep sub boom + wide choir/strings chord of awe. Slow giant cloth-ripping sound (fabric tearing, low and huge) through 11.5. Wind rises.
Anticipation: metallic needle ring / rising whine, snow crunch.
LAUNCH. Punchy drum hit + whoosh blast-off. String ostinato (16ths at 120 BPM) starts and climbs. Wind rush.
Inside cloud: everything low-passed / muffled, dull rushing air.
Burst out above the clouds: filter opens, cymbal swell, soaring horn/strings phrase of the theme.
Slow motion wonder: rhythm drops out, suspended shimmering high pad, glass wind-chime tinkles (beads swaying), soft cloth brush, slow soft heartbeat pulse.
Canyon of light: huge low brass/pad chord swell, roaring bright wind pouring from the tear.
Dive: accelerating whoosh / doppler riser into 24.3.
PIERCE. Sharp thunk-rip through cloth + big drum; then bright angelic high choir shimmer (the light beyond), slightly muffled, until 26.0.
Whipstitch run: full drive. Taiko pattern, ostinato strings, heroic melody. On EVERY half second from 26.5 to 30.5 a pierce: cloth 'thup' + rising thread zip/twang.
Majestic wide: full theme, broad, half-time, brass + strings + choir.
Music cuts to a tense sustained string tremolo cluster. Spool rattle: fast clicking that decelerates and stops at 35.0.
Thread end whips free: sharp whip-snap.
Stitches popping: twang-pops accelerating (35.6, 35.9, 36.15, 36.35, 36.5, 36.62, 36.72, 36.8, 36.87, 36.93), wind roar rising to 37.0.

Slow motion: sound sucked out (low-pass), heartbeat (lub-dub once per second). At 38.2 the catch: tight 'thwip' + single pizzicato. From 38.5 one sustained pure note (first note of her theme) swelling.
Macro knot: wool/yarn creak, music-box theme returns warmer; riser builds; knot snaps tight at 41.6 (small taut 'tok'); riser peaks into 42.5.
Red run: full orchestra reprise, a whole tone higher, more urgent. Pierces on every half second 43.0 ... 46.5.
Last pierce: biggest thunk-rip.
THE PULL: massive rising riser (shepard-like), straining rope creak, a 'zzzzip' of the seam cinching racing away, choir crescendo.
SKY CLOSES: enormous boom, then everything cuts to near silence; only a long reverb tail and a few bead chimes swinging (50.9-52.0).
Quiet. Gentle wind, one soft exhale of breath (52.4), a single bead chime (53.2). Solo music box / piano plays her theme, tender.
Final wide: warm string chord under the theme's resolution. Soft shimmer at 57.0 (constellation twinkles, title). Last note at 58.5 rings out; fade to silence by 59.8.
